$comment: App Store listing settings that are not per-locale text (the texts live in <locale>/*.txt beside this file). Applied by `node src/store/asc-listing.mjs --apply`. `copyright` may use {year}. `ageRating` holds the answers of Apple's questionnaire that lead to 4+; Apple adds questions from time to time - when the API rejects the set, the script says so and the remaining questions are answered once in App Store Connect. `releaseType` MANUAL keeps the release button in the owner's hands after approval.
